# Feature: Game Setup Spieleinstellungen Modal

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
On Play GameSetup (bot phase), match options live in a dismissible „Spieleinstellungen“ modal (V5 pack status + Artefakt-Auktion). Kartenset panel keeps only header + Spieleinstellungen button (plus outdated warning when applicable).

## Preconditions
- App open on Play → Gegen Bot setup (`phase === 'bot'`)
- Modal primitive from `src/components/ui/Modal` available

## Happy Path
- [ ] Bot setup shows button labeled „Spieleinstellungen“ with `data-testid="game-setup-settings"`
- [ ] Clicking the button opens a modal titled „Spieleinstellungen“ with `data-testid="game-setup-settings-modal"`
- [ ] Modal contents order: (1) V5 Formel status card (`data-testid="game-pack-v5"`), (2) Artefakt-Auktion checkbox (`data-testid="game-setup-artifact-auction"`), default unchecked
- [ ] Kartenset panel body does **not** show the big V5 status card (header + settings button only; outdated warning still allowed)
- [ ] Modal closes via Schließen (X) or backdrop click (`dismissible`)
- [ ] „Partie starten“ still passes `enableArtifactAuction` from checkbox state (false by default)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Closing and reopening modal preserves checkbox state for the current setup session
- [ ] Checking Artefakt-Auktion then starting match wires `enableArtifactAuction: true` as before

## Regression
- [ ] Charakterauswahl / Zufällig still work
- [ ] Modus wählen back navigation still works
- [ ] Outdated-formula warning under Kartenset still renders when applicable
- [ ] Online PvP phase unchanged

## Assumptions
- Button lives in the Kartenset panel header (right of „Kartenset“ label)
- V5 card is informational (always V5) — not a pack picker
- Short checkbox label inside modal; longer playtest hint optional under the control
